verdict.rationale: Scheduled or recurring payments and jobs are a plausible capability for a banking-as-a-service API, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents one-off API calls (ACH, wire, book transfers) and event-driven webhooks, which are not recurring schedules. Monthly statement generation is a platform output, not a user-defined recurring job, so nothing shows the product can schedule recurring workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
